title: modular test-facility service and architecture fragments

specimens.name: Flush gasketed electronics service-panel edge
specimens.description: TOP ROW CELL 1 ONLY. Local beige-gray precision service-panel edge in a folded metal frame with a visible compressible gasket line and exactly two captive quarter-turn fasteners; fragment only, not a complete hatch, wall or cabinet.

specimens.name: Removable perforated equipment-bay ventilation panel fragment
specimens.description: TOP ROW CELL 2 ONLY. Short light-gray folded panel fragment with a regular field of small identical ventilation perforations, precision flange edges and captive mounting points; no fan, filter, rack or enclosure.

specimens.name: Replaceable formed-louver cassette fragment
specimens.description: TOP ROW CELL 3 ONLY. Compact rectangular formed-metal louver cassette fragment with evenly repeated narrow louvers and four integrated captive mounting points; physical cassette only, no wall, fan or machine.

specimens.name: Insulated wall-panel to anodized service-frame connection
specimens.description: TOP ROW CELL 4 ONLY. One local sandwich-panel edge meeting a slim anodized-aluminium service-frame/mullion profile with a clean gasketed clip connection; no complete wall, facade, door or room.

specimens.name: Raised technical-floor panel on adjustable pedestal head
specimens.description: BOTTOM ROW CELL 1 ONLY. Small anti-static raised-floor panel corner resting on one adjustable steel pedestal head with precise factory hardware; local floor-system fragment only, no room, cable bundle or equipment.

specimens.name: Removable service-trench cover edge fragment
specimens.description: BOTTOM ROW CELL 2 ONLY. Short anti-slip metal trench-cover fragment seated in a precise recessed support frame with one flush lifting slot; no visible cables, pipes, complete trench or floor scene.

specimens.name: Precision equipment plinth-to-floor isolation interface
specimens.description: BOTTOM ROW CELL 3 ONLY. Local painted-steel equipment plinth/base fragment seated on one dark elastomer isolation layer and a smooth precision grout/concrete pad; no full machine, column or building.

specimens.name: Anodized partition/service-frame corner with replaceable gasket
specimens.description: BOTTOM ROW CELL 4 ONLY. Small 90-degree anodized-aluminium frame-corner fragment with clean mitred/extruded geometry and one replaceable dark gasket channel; no glazing, complete partition, door, window or room.

complete hatches, complete doors, complete windows, complete floor systems or full service trenches

rust, heavy distress, crude concrete interfaces or irregular hand-made fasteners
baked cast shadows, contact shadows, glow, bloom, rays or temporary FX
